system.description:
You have been Gunslinging and fighting enough to learn how to fight around your Soul Armament, using your limited range to its best advantage. You gain 4 Maneuver Tokens at the start of every combat. All tokens are lost at the end of combat. Maneuver Tokens can be expended on the following abilities, each of which cost 1 Token and 1 Stamina.

  • Showdown | Swift Action: When the creature turns to face you, you immediately fire a surprise shot. Your next Focused Attack action gains +5 to its attack roll.
  • Put 'Em Down | Swift Action: Your next Focused Attack actions base damage is increased by [3 x Soul].
  • Fancy Footwork | Swift Action: Your Dodge and Evasion increase by 2 until the start of the next Player Phase.
